See also: Chiesa

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Latin ecclēsia, a borrowing from Ancient Greek ἐκκλησία (ekklēsía, “assembly”).

The original geminated -cc-, though lost in the standard language, is still found in many regional Italian varieties.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈkjɛ.za/[1]
    • Rhymes: -ɛza
    • Hyphenation: chiè‧sa
    • Homophone: Chiesa
  • IPA(key): /ˈkje.za/[1]
    • Audio (una chiesa):(file)
    • Rhymes: -eza
    • Hyphenation: chié‧sa
    • Homophone: Chiesa

Noun

[edit]

chiesa f (plural chiese)

  1. church
    Synonym: parrocchia

Derived terms

[edit]
  • chiesastico
  • chiesuola (“binnacle”)

[edit]
